cover.headline: AI found *948* ways to root Linux. About *$1,280* each.
cover.sub: Five moves from the last 48 hours that change a builder's week, plus three new courses.

items.title: OpenAI's unreleased cyber model wrote *948* root exploits
items.statLabel: working Linux root exploits from one research run
items.what: A mid-October run took 2,308 candidate kernel bugs, reproduced 1,724 and turned 948 into working local privilege escalations.
items.why: That is about $1,280 of API credits per exploit. Attackers can buy the same run, so price AI security review like a pentest.

items.title: Cloudflare open-sourced its *security audit* skill
items.statLabel: roughly: the share of repeat-run findings one run catches
items.what: One set of agents hunts. A fresh agent then tries to disprove each finding before it reaches the report. MIT licensed.
items.why: Split the agent that finds from the agent that checks. Then schedule it, because one run misses about half.

items.title: OpenAI Images 2.6: *50% faster*, now with GIFs
items.statLabel: API tiers: Flare for speed, Sunburst for detail
items.what: Live in ChatGPT, Codex and the API since 4 Nov. Adds marked-up edit regions and SVG export.
items.why: Draft on Flare, finish on Sunburst. SVG export puts generated assets into design files, not only into feeds.

items.title: Meta bought Conductor. Its cloud shuts on *20 Nov*
items.statLabel: from read-only on 13 Nov to shutdown
items.what: Conductor splits one coding project across several AI agents. Deletion of cloud user data starts on 20 Nov.
items.why: Agent tooling is consolidating. Keep an export path and a second tool someone has already tested.

items.title: SWE-2 Flash runs at *one-fifth* of SWE-2's price
items.what: Cognition's new model: 276B parameters with 12B active, built on Thinking Machines' Inkling-Small. Weights withheld.
items.why: Route routine tasks to the cheap tier and judge it on cost per finished task, not per token.

courses.note: Graham Neubig and Daniel Fried on harnesses, evals and RL. Lectures post as the term runs to 3 Dec.

courses.note: Badged hot and new, rated 4.6 from 165 reviews, updated October 2026.

courses.note: 28 lectures in 2h 35m on CLAUDE.md, skills, MCP, hooks and scheduling. Updated October 2026.

read: Finding a path to root now costs about *$1,280*. Routine coding just got a tier at *one-fifth* the price. Whoever owns the budget line for AI review now decides how secure the product is.
takeaway: Put AI security review on the launch checklist, with a budget and a schedule.
